speaker: Doctor
text: I see you've had fatigue, flank pain, and fever following antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. Have you noticed any burning sensation during urination or increased frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The combination of fever, flank pain, and fatigue following a recent infection strongly suggests an ascending urinary tract infection that has reached the kidneys. I will be requesting a Urinalysis and urine culture to confirm the diagnosis and identify the causative organism.
